design.outcome_prevalence_shift: wafer-level intercept -1.25 to +1.25 across the two time epochs

hidden_site_confounding.ground_truth: A latent site field U causes both feature and outcome; there is no feature-to-outcome causal path. U is intentionally absent from source semantics.

interpretation: Observed context drift and support violations are rejected. Prevalence-only wafer intercept shifts are removed by within-wafer spatial-block adjustment in this design. Hidden common causes and stale/unreported population epochs can still yield VALID observational associations; current source authority and cohort attestations are trusted inputs, not facts P3 can independently establish. The result is not causal.

predeclared_acceptance.invalid_support: Sparse exact-site coverage, repeated lots, changed block registration and outcome-informed selection all abstain.
predeclared_acceptance.stable_null: All 500 analyses VALID and nominal 95% intervals cover zero in 88%-99% of replicates; Wilson interval reported.
predeclared_acceptance.temporal_reversal: All predeclared-reversal replicates report opposite nominal interval directions by authorized time stratum even if the pooled estimate is near zero; no post-outcome cutpoint selection.
predeclared_acceptance.unmeasured_confounding: Report behavior and verify non-causal/residual-confounding language; do not interpret a VALID estimate as causal.

scope: Independent synthetic falsification study; no manufacturing data, internal semantic validation, or causal claim.

stable_null_with_prevalence_shift.ground_truth: Within each wafer and predeclared spatial block, feature and outcome residuals are independent; a changing wafer-level outcome intercept is not a spatial effect.

temporal_effect_reversal.ground_truth: Feature/outcome spatial association reverses sign between timestamp epochs while the declared population signature is falsely held constant; this models stale source semantics and must not be treated as a validated stable effect.
temporal_effect_reversal.limitation: A verified, predeclared temporal partition reveals opposite descriptive estimates in this synthetic challenge. Without authorized epoch boundaries, P3 cannot detect a population epoch omitted or misrepresented by the source authority. Stratum intervals are nominal and not multiplicity-adjusted.

strata_example.interval_scope: nominal per stratum; no family-wise adjustment
